test_batched_normal: test the batched function with an iterable whose size is divisible by the batch size
test_batched_uneven: test the batched function with an iterable whose size is not divisible by the batch size
test_batched_empty: test the batched function with an empty iterable and verify it returns an empty list
test_batched_invalid: test the batched function raises ValueError when given a batch size less than one
test_get_all_non_abstract_subclasses: test the get_all_non_abstract_subclasses function returns all non-abstract subclasses of a given class
